name: Notion Workspace MCP Server
shortDescription: Search pages, query databases, append blocks, and extract structured notes from your Notion workspace.
longDescription: Connect AI assistants to your company knowledge base in Notion. Search documentation, query Notion databases, write new pages, and append meeting summaries directly to workspace docs.
author: suekou

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search for Notion pages and databases by query text.

tools.name: get_page_content

tools.name: append_block_children
tools.description: Append markdown text or checklist blocks to a page.

installSteps.title: Create Notion Integration
installSteps.description: Visit notion.so/profile/integrations and share target pages with your integration.
